title: Hisense VIDAA Smart TV firmware V0000.01.00a.P0220 contains an unauthenticated access vulnerability where a QA build…
description: Hisense VIDAA Smart TV firmware V0000.01.00a.P0220 includes a vulnerability due to an unauthenticated WebDriver automation server exposed on TCP port 4444. This server is part of a QA build of the Google Cobalt browser engine and is accessible without authentication from any LAN-adjacent attacker. Exploitation allows arbitrary JavaScript execution, data exfiltration, persistent display content injection, and filesystem and system-state operations via a native bridge.
